entities.summary:
Bülbül Hatun was a concubine of Sultan Bayezid II of the Ottoman Empire.

She played a significant role in the life of the Ottoman Sultan during his reign from 1481 to 1512.

Bülbül Hatun was known for her intelligence, beauty, and strong will, which earned her the respect and admiration of the Sultan and his court.

Her legacy as a prominent figure in Ottoman history was cemented by her association with the famous Ottoman poet, Fuzûlî.

As a historical figure, Bülbül Hatun embodies the complexities and nuances of life in the Ottoman Empire during the 16th century.

She remains an important figure in the study of Ottoman history, offering valuable insights into the lives of women and the court of the Ottoman Sultan.

Bülbül Hatun's remarkable story is a testament to the enduring power of history to captivate and inspire us.
